_comment: Anchor table for generated held-item sheets (scripts/make_held_sheet.py).
Measured from the real Kaetram sheets, then TUNED against player feedback:
- art block default 13px (~20% smaller than the 16px first attempt);
- blocks are generated at ~55% of that (7px) — see make_held_sheet.py;
- art mass pulled toward the measured grip tip (the stick end of the
real art reaches y32-34) so the item hugs the hand;
- breathing (per-frame dy) ANTI-phase of the body's raw sheet deltas:
the weapon frame canvas (48px) composites at a different origin than
the body (32px), so the body's own measured dy sign lands INVERTED on
screen for the baked art — the first attempt copied the body's sign
directly and items bobbed opposite the player (player up = item down).
Body idle f1/f2 dy-1 => item f1/f2 dy+1; walk likewise flipped.
- atk rows keep the swing poses (rotations + streak), pulled 1px in.
Left facing reuses *_right with flipX (client-side, existing).
